cross_class_positive_control.note: Canonical polymer physical constants (representative handbook values), rank-only positive control. NO coating-performance claim; the in-scope scientific claim is the DGEBA-amine within-family result above.

in_scope_dgeba_amine.data_source: Polymers 2024, 16(1):67 (doi 10.3390/polym16010067 = PMC10780492), CC BY 4.0, already rights-established in-tree. Equilibrium water uptake Q of DGEBA cured with three structurally different diamines under one immersion protocol.
in_scope_dgeba_amine.mechanism: Within a single DGEBA-amine resin family the two parameter-free hydrophilicity descriptors ANTI-correlate with uptake (rho=-0.5): the cycloaliphatic CYDM network has the HIGHEST hydroxyl density yet the LOWEST uptake. The controlling variable is amine-backbone free volume / crosslink density -- rigid cycloaliphatic CYDM packs tightest (0.16%), flexible octamethylene 8CH2DA opens the most free volume (2.0%), rigid aromatic-sulfone DDS is intermediate (1.7%). The free-volume proxy alone (rho=+0.5) captures the extreme but not the polar-sulfone DDS, so with n=3 and >=2 competing effects the model is underdetermined (not statistically significant at n=3 either way).

barrier_water_uptake_engine.theory: Equilibrium water uptake of a polymer film is set by the balance of (i) hydrophilic H-bonding-group affinity (well captured across polymer classes by the Hansen hydrogen-bonding parameter delta_h / polar-group concentration) and (ii) accessible free volume / crosslink density that hosts sorbed and clustered water. This is the barrier property governing marine osmotic blistering and cathodic disbondment.
barrier_water_uptake_engine.verdict: BARRIER_WATER_UPTAKE__HYDROPHILICITY_RANK_VALID_CROSS_CLASS__WITHIN_DGEBA_AMINE_GROUP_DENSITY_REFUTED_FREE_VOLUME_AND_DATA_CO_LIMITED: a-priori hydrophilic-group density (c_OH, c_polar) ranks equilibrium water uptake across polymer classes (cross-class Spearman 1.00) but ANTI-correlates within the in-scope DGEBA-amine family (Spearman -0.50, n=3), where free volume / crosslink density dominates. The barrier-water axis cannot be promoted; it needs a validated free-volume/crosslink descriptor plus protocol-controlled n>=~10 -- the same wall as network Tg.

coating_application: Marine two-part epoxy-amine anti-corrosion films: equilibrium water uptake is the primary driver of osmotic blistering and cathodic-disbondment kinetics. This increment establishes the physics engine and, more importantly, RED-TEAMS the naive a-priori model against real CC BY 4.0 protocol-controlled data, proving the axis is not promotable yet and stating exactly what it needs.
